title: How France’s Anti-Waste Laws are Boosting Small Repair Shops
title_ko: 프랑스의 폐기물 방지법이 소규모 수리점을 활성화하는 방법
summary: In France, the new Repair Bonus (Bonus Réparation) is making it cheaper for customers to mend their clothes and shoes while preserving a fading craft. Part of the country’s anti-waste law, the scheme is boosting business, attracting new customers, and showing how targeted policies can drive both sustainability and skilled trades forward. title: Finding Balance Through Collaboration and Certification in Portugal’s Eucalyptus Forests
title_ko: 포르투갈 유칼립투스 숲에서 협력과 인증을 통해 균형 찾기
summary: Vast stands of eucalyptus cloak the hills, grown for wood pulp which is used in part to produce manmade cellulosic fibers, (MMCFs) for clothes and other textiles. But in a landscape where the risk of intense forest fires is escalating, there is an increasing desire for balance.
